name: HilltopAds
description: HilltopAds connects your HilltopAds advertising account to AI agents so you can ask about performance in plain language. Advertisers can check account balance, list campaigns and their ads, pull campaign statistics grouped by date, geo, zone, OS or source, view a single campaign, and review a campaign’s source whitelist and blacklist. Publishers can check balance, list sites and zones (or RTB feeds), pull publisher statistics, and retrieve the anti-adblock script for a zone. The connector is read-only.

_published_faq.name: How do I add HilltopAds to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add HilltopAds to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.hilltopads.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the HilltopAds MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: HilltopAds provides these MCP tools: advertiser_get_balance, advertiser_get_blacklist, advertiser_get_campaign, advertiser_get_stats, advertiser_get_whitelist, advertiser_list_inventory, publisher_antiadblock, publisher_get_balance, publisher_get_stats, and publisher_list_inventory.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to HilltopAds?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to HilltopAds in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
HilltopAds requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
HilltopAds is developed by HilltopAds. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
